_comment_physics: Large-box dendrite. epsilon = 0.10 gives A_max/A_min = 1.10/0.833 = 1.32; it is above 1/15, where the unregularised equation is ill-posed, so willmore_beta > 0 is required: willmore_beta = 0.153 = |S| l*^2 with S = (1 + eps)(1 - 15 eps) = -0.55 and the corner length l* = 0.528 W0 (docs/THEORY.md section 4.3). delta = 0.65. Seed uses equilibrium tanh profile with uniform u = -delta (Karma & Rappel 1998).
_comment_grid: 384^3 = 56.6M cells, box 153.2 W0. dx = 0.4 resolves the tanh interface over ~10 grid points (|phi| < 0.9 band spans ~4.2 W0/dx = 10.4 cells). Measured on an RTX 4090: 5.70 GiB of GPU memory (108.1 bytes per cell with willmore_beta > 0), 906 MB per checkpoint, up to 630 MB per .vts.
_comment_time: Euler with the linearly implicit Willmore step. dt = 0.00125 is the largest dt whose time error does not exceed the spatial error at h = 0.4 (docs/THEORY.md section 4.3); the explicit thermal update is stable below 0.0261. max_steps = 160000 (t = 200) is an upper bound: the saturation guard stops the run cleanly when the crystal reaches the walls (measured: step 91200, t = 114; six <100> arms with concave faces between them by then). 118 ms per step on an RTX 4090: 179 minutes to saturation.
_comment_output: VTK every 2000 steps (2.5 time units): 47 frames up to saturation, up to 630 MB each, 21.5 GB in total.
_comment_checkpoint: Checkpoint every 8000 steps (10 time units, 15.7 minutes of compute on an RTX 4090). 906 MB per checkpoint, keep_last = 3: 2.7 GB.
_comment_initial: r0=10 cells = 4.0 W0, well above critical radius R_c = 2*d0/delta = 1.54 = 3.85 cells. Tanh initial profile avoids spurious interface-relaxation transient.
